mentions.name: G-Scope
mentions.description: G-Scope is a free, cross-platform application (Windows, macOS, Linux, Android) for digital microscopes. It works with almost any UVC microscope and several Wi-Fi models, and offers photo/video capture, calibrated measurements, annotations, panorama stitching, and PDF report generation. Some pro features require a one-time purchase. Everything runs locally with no account, subscription, cloud, or telemetry.
mentions.problem: Most USB microscopes come with poor software, often limited to one brand or operating system.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on G-Scope, a free application for digital microscopes, available for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android.
mentions.author: eduramiba
